name: Gelatti
summary: **Gelatti** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Cookie Fam Genetics]], the Cookies brand's breeding arm. A cross of [[gelato|Gelato]] and [[biscotti|Biscotti]], the original cut bred and sold by Cookies is no longer available in seed or clone form, though other breeders have released their own Gelatti crosses under the name.
